header.running_head: Refraining from Killing Muslims and the Abomination of Fighting for Land

blocks.text:

Alternatively, you may open up a door from your house apart from the one where they are stationed, from where you can mount your animal and go to Makkah. They shall never regard your blood as lawful (for them to spill) as long as you are there. Another option is that you go to Shaam where the people of Shaam are there for you as well as Mu'aawiya (RA)."
Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) replied, "I cannot go out and fight them because I never want to be the first of the Ummah of Rasulullaah ﷺ to shed (the) blood (of Muslims). Although they will never regard my blood to be lawful if I go to Makkah, I have heard Rasulullaah ﷺ say, 'A man from the Quraysh will go to Makkah and be a cause of spreading irreligiousness. He shall suffer the punishment of half the universe.' I never want that man to be me. I cannot also go to Shaam although the people of Shaam and Muaa'wiya are there because I shall never leave the place of Hijrah and the proximity of Rasulullaah ﷺ."[^1]
Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) Forbids some of the Sahabah (RA) From Fighting when he was Under Siege

Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) reports that he entered Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA)'s house when he was under siege and said, "O Ameerul Mu'mineen! It has now become permissible for you to fight these rebels." Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) asked, "O Abu Hurayrah! Would you like to kill all of mankind including myself?" "Certainly not," replied Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA). Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) then said, "By Allaah! If you kill a single person it is tantamount to killing all of mankind." Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) then returned without fighting.[^2]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Zubayr (RA) entered Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA)'s house and said, "O Ameerul Mu'mineen! In your house you have such a group of people who will attract the help of Allaah (when fighting the rebels) even though they may be few in number. Please issue the command so that we may fight." Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) said, "I am pleading to every man in the name of Allaah that he should not have his blood spilt for me and should not spill the blood of another for me." Another narration states that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Zubayr (RA) said to Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA), "Fight them because Allaah has made it permissible for you to fight them." Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) replied, "Never! I swear by Allaah that I shall never fight them."[^3]
Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Aamir (RA) narrates that when he was under siege in his house, Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) said, "The one most useful to me is he who restrains his hand and his weapon."[^4]
